cluster_reason: These two parser base classes have an explicit internal dependency, forming a cohesive inheritance and implementation foundation for the asynchronous parsers. Moving them together preserves their close relationship and avoids splitting the base implementation across packages. No external incoming dependencies are reported, so the main required adjustments are limited to references from the remaining concrete parser classes.

blocks.goal: Move the cohesive asynchronous parser base-class cluster into a dedicated subpackage.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage if it does not exist.
Move the shared asynchronous JSON parser base class to the destination package.
Move the UTF-8 asynchronous JSON parser base class together with its direct base-class dependency.
